# FocusGraphSpec&lt;Id *extends* `string`, Key *extends* `string`, Prefix *extends* `string` = `Id`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:95](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L95)

A focus tree with topology checked against the exact keys of `nodes`.

## Remarks

Sequences and joins generate native prerequisite groups. Each choice
group creates pairwise, symmetric mutual exclusions. Defaults position nodes
by dependency depth, with columns assigned in declaration order within a row.
